final_message:
I couldn't reproduce this at 6f37b07. That checkout is eslint 9.15.0, and there `no-lonely-if` doesn't report the snippet from the report at all, so no fix is applied. The bug does reproduce on the published 9.12.0, 9.13.0 and 9.14.0 releases. The repro script below runs the same check against any of them.

**What the repro shows (on 9.14.0)**
- The rule reports `3:9 Unexpected if as the only statement in an else block.`
- The fix rewrites `else { if (false) {} }` to `else if (false) {}`. The outer `else throw ...` then binds to the lifted inner `if`, which has no `else` of its own (a dangling-`else` problem).
- The original code runs without error; the fixed code throws "This `else` should have been unreachable!".
- Five more variants of the same shape also get unsafe fixes on 9.14.0: a chained `else if` in the block, a labeled inner `if`, a comment before the outer `else`, an outer `else if` chain, and an empty-statement consequent.
- At this checkout, none of the six cases is reported and every output is unchanged.

**Why the checkout doesn't reproduce it.** In `lib/rules/no-lonely-if.js`, the rule only reports when `!astUtils.areBracesNecessary(parent, sourceCode)`. That helper (`lib/rules/utils/ast-utils.js`, also used by `curly`) returns true here for two reasons: the block's only statement is an `if` with no `else`, and the token after the block is `else`. So the dangling-`else` case is already guarded at this revision. I worked out which release changed by testing published versions only; per your rules, I didn't read git history or look up the fix.

**The patch.** It only adds `repro-19033.js` at the repo root. It runs the snippet from the report plus the five variants through `Linter` and executes each original and fixed program. It exits 1 if any fix changes behaviour. `ESLINT_PATH` points it at a different eslint package; without it, it uses this checkout.

- `node repro-19033.js`: this checkout, prints "Not reproduced", exit 0.
- The run command below installs eslint@9.14.0 into `/tmp` and runs the script against it: "BUG REPRODUCED: 6/6", exit 1.
run_command: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh >/dev/null; npm i -q --no-audit --no-fund --prefix /tmp/eslint-9.14.0 eslint@9.14.0 >/dev/null 2>&1 && ESLINT_PATH=/tmp/eslint-9.14.0/node_modules/eslint node repro-19033.js
